_comment: Static tool declaration required by the v1.28 manifest schema (remoteMcpServer.mcpToolDescription). MUST mirror the tools registered in mcp-server/server.ts — names, inputSchema and annotations. Headless demo: no _meta.ui (no widgets). build.mjs checks the names match.

tools.name: chess_new_game
tools.title: Start a new chess game
tools.description: Resets the board to the starting position and begins a fresh self-play game (you will play BOTH sides). Returns the starting report including White's legal moves. Call this exactly once at the start of a game.

tools.name: chess_read_board
tools.title: Read the chess board
tools.description: Returns the current position: whose turn it is, the PGN so far, the full legal-move list in SAN, both sides' pieces, and the FEN. You normally do NOT need this — every chess_make_move response already includes the next side's legal moves. Call it only to recover if you have lost track of the position.

tools.name: chess_make_move
tools.title: Make the next chess move
tools.description: Plays one move for whichever side is to move (self-play: you alternate White and Black). `move` is one move in SAN (e.g. "Nf3", "exd5", "O-O") or UCI (e.g. "e2e4"). The response reports the new position AND the next side's legal moves — pick your next move from that list without calling chess_read_board. On an illegal move the error lists the legal moves; retry with one of them. When the game ends the response contains the final result and a game summary — report it to the user and stop.

move.description: One move in SAN (e.g. "Nf3") or UCI (e.g. "e2e4") for the side to move.
